caption:
You used to feel it. Has the cross gone cold on you? It's not a relic behind glass — it's today's news, still for you. (Galatians 3:1 devotional)

Paul says Christ was publicly placarded before your eyes as crucified — you already saw it, and it still holds you now. You can't split the Christian life into "grace to start, my effort to grow"; the same life of Christ runs all the way through. You died there with Him, and no one hands a dead man a bill.
